content: Ecommerce/online-ordering consensus (Shopify data): forced account creation causes measurable cart abandonment (up to ~28% of shoppers abandon if forced to create an account; guest checkout reduces abandonment materially, cited ~24%, and removing forced account creation yields a 4-9% absolute completion-rate lift). Best practice is a hybrid: default to guest checkout at time of purchase, then prompt post-purchase account creation ('save your order, track status, earn rewards') which converts 30-50% of guests into accounts within about a week with zero checkout-time friction cost. Guest checkout trades off first-party data capture for conversion; account checkout enables faster repeat purchase and personalization.
